gloss: when one's stomach is empty; on an empty stomach

definitions.gloss: when one's stomach is empty; on an empty stomach
definitions.explanation: The time or state of having an empty stomach. Frequently used in medical and pharmaceutical instructions.

examples.japanese: この{薬|くすり}は{空腹時|くうふくじ}に{飲|の}んでください。
examples.english: Please take this medicine on an empty stomach.

examples.japanese: {空腹時|くうふくじ}にコーヒーを{飲|の}むと{胃|い}が{痛|いた}くなる。
examples.english: Drinking coffee on an empty stomach gives me a stomachache.

examples.japanese: {空腹時|くうふくじ}の{運動|うんどう}は{血糖値|けっとうち}が{下|さ}がりやすいので{注意|ちゅうい}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: Exercise on an empty stomach can easily lower blood sugar, so caution is needed.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of {空腹|くうふく} (empty stomach, hunger) and {時|じ} (time, when). Very common on medicine packaging and in medical instructions. The opposite is {食後|しょくご} (after meals).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {空腹時|くうふくじ}に{服用|ふくよう}する (to take medicine on an empty stomach)
- {空腹時|くうふくじ}の{血糖値|けっとうち} (fasting blood sugar level)
- {空腹時|くうふくじ}に{飲|の}む (to drink on an empty stomach)

RELATED WORDS:
- {食前|しょくぜん}: before meals
- {食後|しょくご}: after meals
- {食間|しょっかん}: between meals
